parsed.rationale: All six members are empty type-alias-object declarations (fields_or_signature: []) that serve as SwiftUI @main entry-point aliases, each carrying a distinct name tied to its own app target or sample-app module: WXUISampleApp, WallpaperSampleApp, PlayerHeaderViewApp, PlayerHeaderViewSampleApp, WatchXYC, and WXYCTVApp. The structural similarity (shared_field_count: 1, no differing_slots) is purely coincidental — each alias must exist in its own module to satisfy the @main protocol requirement for that specific executable target. Merging or extracting them would break per-target entry-point resolution. Although the pipeline did not flag is_sample_app=true on these records, the file paths (e.g., Examples/WXUISampleApp/Sources/, Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/, Examples/PlayerHeaderViewSampleApp/Sources/) confirm sample-app and standalone-app roles that require independent entry points.
